prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Sync Your Pet Companion", "Use your primary account so your companion and past adoptions stay linked.", "Signing in ensures your desktop companion is backed up safely.", "Important: Sign in with your original account to retrieve existing pets"]
1: ["Check Photo Quality", "Ensure your pet photo is clear and well-lit for accurate desktop rendering.", "Uploaded Photo Preview", "Single pet in frame, Good lighting, Sharp focus", "Confirm & Generate Pet"]
2: ["Testing Desktop Window Rendering", "Verifying display permissions and desktop overlay compatibility for your pet.", "Click below if your pet is visible on your screen background.", "Pet Visible, Continue"]
3: ["Meet Your Official Companion", "Your companion certificate is ready with custom attributes and personality.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
4: ["Welcome to Your New Desktop Life", "Discover AI companions that live, react, and play right on your monitor screen.", "Choose My Path"]
5: ["Generating Your Pet Companion...", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will play a sound when your pet arrives."]
6: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a friend style to bring onto your screen.", "Classic Pixel Pet vs 3D Desktop Buddy"]
7: ["Select How You Want to Adopt", "Upload your own photo or pick from ready-to-play desktop companions.", "Custom Creation: Unique pet built from photo", "Instant Companion: Ready-to-use pet species"]
8: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Your pet is now active on your computer screen. Click below to start interacting.", "Start Playing with Pet"]
9: ["Setup Complete - Pet is Active", "Look at your desktop taskbar and screen corners to find your companion.", "Tip: Right-click your pet on screen anytime to access controls, settings, or hide it.", "Active on Desktop Taskbar & Main Screen"]
